preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: result == '' or all(result[i] == result[-(i+1)] for i in range(len(result) // 2))
len(result) >= len(S[i:j]) for any i, j in range(len(S)) if S[i:j] == S[i:j][::-1]
postconditions.description: The result is the longest palindromic substring in S.

postconditions.expression: if len(result) == len(S[i:j]) for any i, j in range(len(S)) if S[i:j] == S[i:j][::-1] then i <= j
postconditions.description: In case of a tie, the result has the least starting index.
